title: AN5836 VD55G0 visible domain limitation

first_page_excerpt: Introduction VD55G0 is sensitive to ultra-high and sharp illumination in the visible domain, whether the sensor is powered/streaming or not. Some very powerful light sources (such as the sun) can create artifacts on the image sensor. VD55G0 visible domain limitation AN5836 Application note AN5836 - Rev 1 - June 2022 For further information contact your local STMicroelectronics sales office. www.st.com
